entities.summary: Sebastian Korda is an American professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 15 achieved on August 12, 2024 and a best doubles ranking of No. 46, reached on March 31, 2025. He has won four ATP Tour titles combined, three in singles and one in doubles.
